title: Involuntary termination of a synced commercial lender under legal hold
narrative: HR and Legal schedule a 10:00 termination meeting. At 09:58 IT disables the AD DS account (source of authority) and revokes Entra sessions, then removes MFA methods. Legal requires a litigation hold, so the hold is placed and OneDrive transferred to the manager while the E3 license is still assigned. The corporate laptop is wiped after collection; the personal iPhone is only retired (selective wipe). Audit evidence is exported last.
